Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — FastPay is excited to move to a hands-on POC. We'd like to kick off with a 2.5 hour workshop focused on: prompt review (our payment reconciliation prompts), routing/inference routing decisions, and a short load test on our sample traffic.

Proposed windows (all ET):
- Tue, Feb 24, 10:00–12:30
- Wed, Feb 25, 13:00–15:30

We prefer onsite at our NYC office if possible (we can arrange visitor badges), but virtual is fine too. A few logistics/questions up front:
- Will your team need network access to our staging environment or will you run the load test from Redwood infra?
- Any constraints on recording the session? Our security team prefers meetings not be recorded without approval.
- Who will drive the prompt review from your side (SE vs solutions)?

Attendees from FastPay: Claire Hughes (Product), Roberto Vega (SRE), Amy Lin (Security, may join briefly).

Thanks — can you confirm availability and any prep we should complete?

Regards,
Claire Hughes

Hi Claire — great to hear FastPay is ready to get hands-on. Both windows look workable for us, with a couple of caveats:

1) Onsite vs virtual: we can do either. If onsite, please note our engineers will need visitor badges for access and the ability to share their screens over the room system. If virtual, we'll use Zoom and can share the recording only with explicit permission.

2) Load testing: our default is to run load tests from Redwood-managed instances (so we don't need VPN into your staging). If you'd prefer Redwood to hit your staging environment directly, we'll need a short whitelist window and an endpoint + credentials.

3) Prep: I've attached a draft agenda and a load-test plan for your review. Can you confirm if Amy (security) needs us to disable recording or hold recording until legal signs off?

I'll loop in the SEs to assign owners for prompt review and routing. If Feb 24/25 are both options on your side, please pick one and, if possible, propose two-timeslots within the half-day window so we can align.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
